SELECT i.i_item_id,
       AVG(pss.ss_quantity) AS agg1,
       AVG(pss.ss_list_price) AS agg2,
       AVG(pss.ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3,
       AVG(pss.ss_sales_price) AS agg4
FROM (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk,
           ss.ss_quantity,
           ss.ss_list_price,
           ss.ss_coupon_amt,
           ss.ss_sales_price,
           ss.ss_promo_sk
    FROM date_dim d
    JOIN store_sales ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2001
      AND cd.cd_gender = 'F'
      AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'W'
      AND cd.cd_education_status = 'College'
) AS pss
JOIN (
    SELECT p_promo_sk
    FROM promotion
    WHERE p_channel_email = 'N' OR p_channel_event = 'N'
) AS pf ON pss.ss_promo_sk = pf.p_promo_sk
JOIN item i ON pss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
GROUP BY i.i_item_id
ORDER BY i.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
